summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-ext-common 0.7.7 ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it executable, and then invokes `bun math_init.js` (execFileSync) against a sibling file in the package. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated string-array / dispatch bundle with a shuffled numeric constant table and no readable behavior. setup.mjs itself is obfuscator.io-style mangled (`_0xNNNNNN` identifiers, per-function string-lookup dictionaries). The advertised purpose of the package is a React/Anvil2 UI component library, which has no need for a preinstall lifecycle, an alternate JavaScript runtime download, or an obfuscated multi-hundred-KB sibling script. Executing the alternate-runtime path bypasses Node-only tooling and inspection. The alternate-runtime install path plus obfuscated payload plus purpose-mismatch on a scoped enterprise package name is the alternate-runtime-dropper fingerprint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
